state: fixed before constructing new auxiliary allocations or running new support outcomes
fixed_choices: Same archive label respondent orders. The first 24 label draws and first 5 or 10 respondents in each. All menus per respondent.
frozen_teacher: Reuse archived predictor and the original training/holdout/pool split. Only correction pool records are touched.
auxiliary: For each fixed label draw, eight independently permuted, without-replacement groups of 64 remaining respondents. Draws are deterministic and shared across power; no evaluations or labels select groups.
comparison: Count label allocations with observed interior and exterior outcomes when only the auxiliary design changes. Compare powers separately. Also record ordinary labelled support.
uncertainty_scope: Descriptive overlapping label and auxiliary allocations within two released fixed datasets. No causal or population inference.
verification: Strict feasibility using two primal formulations. For every exterior case, verify a negative recession direction on original available menus. Keep numerical boundary and rank issues in denominators.
